tasks.title: Implement approved Configuration version saving deployment and rollback
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: After exact R09 screenshot approval, implement one Configuration page with actual immutable coherent saved versions, exact deployed selection, local JSON editing/save and Deploy any saved version including rollback. Reuse existing native setup/publication/release/whole-map clients with separate originals, actual current grants/session, exact bytes and fresh reviewed ETags; Save never silently deploys and Deploy explicitly replaces targeting for this configuration after the all-instance review. Preserve known committed stages and recovery on partial/unknown results without new-key replay or reload continuation. Correct the duplicate creation/editor dirty ownership and Back/breadcrumb/deploy navigation with one discard decision, and contain/rescale the actual editor and list at changing desktop widths. No new backend/framework/counter or normal canary/release/assignment maze. Include the user-requested collapsed bottom Compare versions panel: compare the selected saved version against the actual currently deployed version for a bounded read-only JSON diff, without a second version picker, no mutation or hidden source data disclosure.
tasks.validation: Use existing pure and real native fixtures to verify saved history and deployed selection, exact pair rollback, single user Save with distinct native effects and truthful partial/recovery, no assignment after Save, whole-map replacement only after Deploy confirmation, conflict/session/read-only denial, exact large-number/Unicode bytes, new-name handoff, one canceled/accepted dirty navigation, and editor/list geometry at narrow/wide changing desktop viewports. Include scoped builds, docs, independent review and actual cleanup. Preserve earlier Windows Node failures and historical evidence; no broad qualification or Scheduler work. Compare tests retain exact numeric/string tokens, demonstrate additions/removals/changes and permission/session/version mismatch handling with bounded memory/output; comparison never submits any native mutation. The deployed comparison baseline must match the fresh exact uniform assignment map; no deployed/targeted/stale states are explicit, and deployment changes invalidate or refresh the baseline.
